spec: Write char_at(s, i) returning the character of string s at position i using ONE-BASED indexing: char_at('abc', 1) == 'a'. Raise IndexError when i is out of range (i < 1 or i > len(s)).
Write sign(n) that returns the STRING 'positive' when n > 0, 'negative' when n < 0, and 'zero' when n == 0. The return value must be one of those exact lowercase English words, not a number.
Write nth_even(n) returning the n-th positive even number, counting 2 as the FIRST: nth_even(1) == 2, nth_even(2) == 4, nth_even(3) == 6.
